hypothesis: For the selected 64x32 parent, replacing the padded 64x33 shared tile with a 64x32 XOR-swizzled layout may change shared-memory access behavior and reduce padding, but the indexing cost could offset any benefit. Prior measured variants show that the padded vector-ownership candidate (cef4bbb63e3e49cf, 3.142 us) was faster than the padded scalar 32x32 candidate (e8b5e81f11b14f29, 3.398 us), XOR-swizzled scalar 32x32 (5f05ca36bcd347ee, 3.253 us), and selected padded 64x32 parent (677cd6c7769f4f38, 3.703 us); this different 64x32 XOR layout tests rather than assumes the swizzle's value.
